title: A Gothic Quarter experience that cannot be missed.
text: The tour of the Barcelona Cathedral was wonderful.  Our tour guide Lalia was very knowledgeable amd helped explain the history very well. Visiting in November when the weather is milder and the Gothic Quarter streets are less crowded made the tour experience more enjoyable.  The history is rich and the view from the Terrace is fantastic.
